summary: Iter 15 verified end-to-end. Backend regression 30/30 (iter7+10+11) + 13/13 (iter13 billing) + 3/3 (new iter15 invoice-staff). Frontend POS bug-fix A (guest dropdown text color rgb(30,41,59)) and bug-fix B (per-line Staff column + cart-line-staff-{i} dropdown) confirmed. Default-stylist pre-fill behaviour proven: both new lines auto-fill with the top-bar default; overriding line 0 leaves line 1 untouched. POST /api/invoices captured with per-line staff_id/staff_name and the response echoes them. Receipt modal renders 'by <staff name>' under each item (verified in screenshot). InvoiceItem optional staff fields accept None and full strings without 422.

minor.issue: No single-invoice GET endpoint exists; only GET /api/invoices list. Not a regression; test adjusted to verify persistence via list.

critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx line 401: empty-state row colspan correctly updated from 8 to 9 to match the new Staff column.
InvoiceItem (server.py 409-417) staff_id/staff_name are Optional[str] with None defaults — fully backward compatible; old clients without these fields still POST 201.

POS.jsx setLineStaff (line 141-144) correctly looks up staff.name from id and writes both into the cart-row state; receipt HTML, in-app modal, and WhatsApp share message all share the same per-line staff_name read path.
addToCart (line 135-136) copies default stylist from top-bar select into each new cart row — verified in browser: both new rows show the default in cart-line-staff-{i}.
Pre-existing dev-only React hydration warning (auto-instrumented <span> inside <option>) is the same warning flagged in iter14 — not introduced by iter15.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test invoices via /api/invoices POST during pytest run (TEST_ITER15 customer reused; small ₹500 invoices). One invoice INV-202606-0030 created via UI smoke test (Bablu Kumar, Hair Cut - Women by Rahul Verma + Hair Cut - Men by Priya Sharma).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15 fully green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_invoice_staff.py is reusable regression for per-line staff fields. The pytest suite must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (the test files use os.environ[...] not get-with-default). The xdist parallel runner can intermittently fail TestRevenue.test_revenue_kpis_after_create in iter13 due to cancellation in a parallel worker — run that suite with -o addopts='' to disable xdist if a clean pass is required (confirmed 13/13 green sequentially). The auto-instrumented <span> inside <option> hydration warning is dev-mode only and unrelated to iter14/iter15.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — review tests verified the fixes. The previously reported bugs are fully addressed: (1) select element now has text-slate-800 → computed color rgb(30,41,59); (2) cart table has a dedicated Staff <th>, per-row <select data-testid=cart-line-staff-{i}>, default-stylist pre-fill via addToCart, and per-line staff captured in invoice POST + receipt + WhatsApp + print iframe.
